subject: Interwell: deployment path, SLA targets, and procurement owners
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@interwell.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Interwell: deployment path, SLA targets, and procurement owners

Sanjay — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can get the right folks looped in on next steps.

Summary of what I heard from today
- Primary use case: clinical triage + short-form summarization for patient intake notes.
- Traffic shape: prototype will see bursts during business hours, expected average QPS ~6–12, peak concurrency up to ~40.
- Data sensitivity: PHI present in payloads, Interwell prefers VPC/private deployment options.

Open questions / asks
1) Economic buyer / final approver: who signs the contract? You mentioned Claire Hammond — can you confirm her title and preferred timeline for decision?
2) Procurement & security owners: please confirm the procurement lead and security reviewer email(s). You referenced Tom Li for procurement and a security questionnaire — can you share the SOC 2 request or questionnaire?
3) Latency targets: you mentioned wanting this to feel 'real-time' for clinicians. Can you confirm a p95 latency target (e.g., < 800 ms) and whether p99 matters for you? Also approximate response length (tokens) for the typical request.
4) Cost guardrails: do you have a target cost per 1k tokens or a monthly budget cap for the pilot?

Proposed immediate next steps
- Send you a short security/architecture summary + SOC2 pointer (Ben will own).
- Draft a one-page procurement checklist for Tom (Laura will own).
- Quick follow-up call with Claire + Tom to align timelines and signoff paths — propose Tue or Wed next week.

Attachments: none on this message.

Thanks,

Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192
https://redwood.inference/
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@interwell.health>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.inference>
Cc: Claire Hammond <claire.h@interwell.health>, Tom Li <tom.li@interwell.health>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interwell: deployment path, SLA targets, and procurement owners

Alex — appreciated the clear recap. See answers inline below, and I attached the SOC2 questionnaire we get from vendors.

1) Economic buyer / timeline
- Claire Hammond, VP Engineering (claire.h@interwell.health). Target decision window: 4–6 weeks from today for pilot approval; production decisions will follow Q3 planning.

2) Procurement & security
- Procurement lead: Tom Li (tom.li@interwell.health) — handling contracts and PO.
- Security reviewer: Rachel Gupta, security manager (rachel.g@interwell.health) — she runs the vendor questionnaire.
- Attached: interwell-soc2-request.pdf (pdf, 420 KB) with checklist and evidence request template.

3) Latency / response profiles
- Typical responses: 100–400 tokens (most around 180).
- Target: p95 < 800 ms, p99 < 1.5 s would be ideal for clinician experience. If a deployment mode forces higher tail latency, that's a concern.

4) Cost
- For pilot, procurement is comfortable with a capped TAM of ~$6k–8k USD for platform spend. Unit economics matter — prefer <$0.10 per completed inference for the pilot (we understand notation varies).

Preferences / constraints
- Must be able to run in a customer VPC or private deployment (air-gapped not required for pilot, but VPC w/ HSM integration is a must for PHI).
- Audit logs and token retention controls required.

Next steps
- Please send architecture sketch and security summary by COB Monday.
- We will schedule a procurement + engineering call next Wed (I’ll let Tom/Claire pick a time).

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product, Interwell Health
sanjay@interwell.health | +1 (312) 555-4433

Attachment: interwell-soc2-request.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Interwell: deployment path, SLA targets, and procurement owners

Looping in a short plan based on Sanjay's reply. Copying the relevant excerpt below (quoted).

> Target: p95 < 800 ms, p99 < 1.5 s
> Typical responses: ~180 tokens
> Pilot budget: $6k–8k
> Must support VPC deployment with HSM and audit logs

Suggested internal ask list (owners and due dates):
- Security one-pager + SOC2 evidence map -> Ben -> due: Mon 2027-04-05 COB (attach interwell-soc2-request.pdf to our reply).
- Architecture sketch (VPC diagram, network flow, KMS/HSM integration notes) -> Alex -> due: Mon 2027-04-05 midday.
- Procurement checklist (PO path, contract lead, redlines we typically accept) -> Laura -> due: Mon 2027-04-05 COB.
- Cost/latency tradeoff estimate for a 180-token median response at 12 QPS with 40 concurrency -> Ben + Infra -> due: Tue 2027-04-06.

Notes on SLA and deployment modes
- Dedicated vs Private: we should present two options — Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool in our infra with VPC peering + enhanced audit) vs Redwood Private (customer VPC deployment). For PHI and HSM needs, Private is likely the safer ask but be ready to show Dedicated with VPC peering and HSM options if procurement pushes for simpler onboarding.
- For the p95/p99 targets, we should document expected tail behavior with quantization/instance sizing recommendations and provide fallback plan (auto-failover to a higher-capacity variant) if we can't meet p99 during bursts.

I'll draft the security one-pager and start the latency/cost calc. Alex/Laura — once you have the ops sketch and procurement checklist I will assemble into a single reply to Sanjay/Tom/Claire and propose Wed for the joint call.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference | +1 (617) 555-1102

Attachment referenced: interwell-soc2-request.pdf (from Sanjay)
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@interwell.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interwell: deployment path, SLA targets, and procurement owners

Sanjay — thanks for the fast follow-up and the SOC2 doc, received and shared internally. Quick confirmation of next steps from our side:

- Ben will send a 1–2 page security + evidence mapping referencing your SOC2 attachment by Monday COB (we've started mapping the requested items). Attachment we will include: security-onepager-interwell.pdf.
- I will produce an architecture sketch (see attached: interwell-arch-sketch.png) that shows VPC peering option + private deployment variant.
- Laura will prepare the procurement checklist and typical contract redlines (interwell-procurement-checklist.xlsx).
- Proposed joint call Wednesday 2027-04-07 between 11:00–11:45 PT — Sanjay / Claire / Tom; Alex / Ben / Laura. If that window doesn't work, propose alternatives and we'll adapt. Calendar invite with virtual meeting link to follow.

One clarification on cost signal: when you said <$0.10 per completed inference for pilot, we want to ensure we're comparing apples-to-apples. Ben will include an estimate that shows per-request unit cost at median 180 tokens & projected monthly spend at your expected load.

We will include an appendix in our reply that shows expected p95/p99 under both Dedicated and Private deployment profiles (with suggested instance sizing).

Thanks again — we’ll get materials over Monday and aim to close the pilot agreement within your 4–6 week window.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192
